description.en: The remotes configured in rclone (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, Yandex Disk and dozens of other storages) as folders of the panels (rclone:///). Browse, view with F3, edit with F4, copy and move with F5 and F6, make folders with F7, delete with F8. Adds Rclone to the Change Drive list (Alt+F1 / Alt+F2). Needs rclone in PATH and a configured remote (rclone config).
description.ru: Хранилища, настроенные в rclone (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, Яндекс Диск и десятки других), как папки панелей (rclone:///). Обзор, просмотр F3, правка F4, копирование и перенос F5 и F6, папки F7, удаление F8. Добавляет Rclone в список дисков (Alt+F1 / Alt+F2). Нужны rclone в PATH и настроенное хранилище (rclone config).
